# HasProperty

Tells whether an object has a property of a given name.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
HasProperty(source, name)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | object | The object to look in. Null is read as an empty object, which has no property. Any other value that is not an object is a runtime error. |
| `name` | string | The property name to look for, matched exactly, case included. Null is read as the empty string. A number, a boolean, an array, an object or a function is a runtime error: it is not read as its string form. |

## Returns

Boolean. True when source has a property named name, whatever its value, null included; false otherwise. Never null.

## Example

`HasProperty({"a": null}, "a")` returns true.

`HasProperty({"a": 1}, "A")` returns false.
